units.source_text: 信的内容很简单，或者说是抽象的。

en.t: The contents of the letter were very simple, or rather, abstract.

units.source_text: K只说自己是因为意志薄弱、怯懦无能、感到前途无望而自杀的，

en.t: K merely said that he was killing himself because he was weak-willed, cowardly and incapable, and felt there was no hope for the future,

units.source_text: 然后简短地对我一直以来给予他的帮助表示了感谢，

en.t: then briefly thanked me for all the help I had given him up to then,

units.source_text: 并请我顺带料理一下他死后的丧葬事宜。

en.t: and asked me, while I was at it, to take care of the funeral arrangements after his death.

units.source_text: 还提到自己给夫人惹了麻烦，很过意不去，让我代他向夫人表示歉意，

en.t: He also said that he was very sorry for having caused trouble for the lady of the house, and asked me to apologize to her on his behalf,

units.source_text: 并拜托我通知一下他的家人。

en.t: and he asked me to notify his family.

units.source_text: 总之，拜托之事都非常简要地写上了，唯独不见小姐的名字。

en.t: In short, all the things he wished to entrust to me were written down very briefly, but the young lady's name alone appeared nowhere.

units.source_text: 看到最后，我马上意识到K是有意回避。

en.t: When I had read to the end, I immediately realized that K had avoided mentioning her on purpose.

units.source_text: 但是，最使我痛彻心扉的，是他用剩余的墨在最后添补的一句话：

en.t: But what pierced me most deeply was one sentence he had added at the end with the remaining ink:

units.source_text: ‘本应该早些死的，却不知为何活到今天。’

en.t: “I should have died long ago, yet for some reason I have lived until today.”

units.source_text: 我用颤抖的手把信叠好，重新装入信封。

en.t: With trembling hands, I folded the letter and put it back into the envelope.

units.source_text: 我把信按照原样放在桌子上，以便大家都能看到它。

en.t: I placed the letter back on the desk as it had been, so that everyone could see it.

units.source_text: 然后我回过身来，这才看到了飞溅到隔扇上的斑斑血迹。

en.t: Then I turned around, and only then did I see the blood spattered in spots across the sliding partition.
